executive_summary: All 87 catalogue rows were audited from the attached evidence. The deterministic local build, contracts, feature validator, smoke suite, and local browser checks passed, but they do not disprove the high-confidence production finding that a provider labeled Verification in progress can expose session selection, Request to book, and card checkout. That contradiction is a release stop: feature 27 is downgraded to blocked at 4/10 and feature 32 to blocked at 3/10. The current Getting Started and audit changes are also explicitly unreleased and lack production verification.

critical_stop_conditions: Do not release while any provider in a non-cleared verification state can expose or execute session selection, booking, or checkout.
Do not accept the local trust smoke as sufficient until the exact production Apex state is reproduced and the invariant is tested against every verification status.
Do not claim the current Getting Started or audit changes are live until build stamp 713146f29c7f37a6, or its released successor, is deployed and asserted on production.
Do not run a first paid-booking, refund, payout, or subscription proof until the production trust gate is fail-closed.
evidence_gaps: This evaluation used only the attached evidence; no new shell, filesystem, browser, GitHub, Supabase, Stripe, or external-system check was performed.
The attached current change is local and explicitly not deployed; production behavior for Getting Started is unavailable.
The production trust finding is observational; the attached evidence does not include a network trace, DOM snapshot, booking-write attempt, or backend verification-status query.
Supabase is configured read-only for project tseszaprvtvqrkfpditu, but the capture does not prove a successful authenticated MCP query.
Stripe is configured for read/planning only, but the capture does not prove authenticated account context.
No completed charge, refund, payout, subscription lifecycle, or atomic final-seat race result is present.
No signed-in cross-account RLS matrix, guardian-isolation run, or negative booking insert against an uncleared provider is attached.
The historical audit stopped at feature 34 and cannot independently substantiate rows 35 through 87.
The four family contrast findings and ten legacy thin blocks reported as smoke warnings are not enumerated individually in the attached evidence.
